_note: The salary that gratuity (Sch. III / s.19(1) Table Sl. 6) and leave encashment (Sl. 14) are measured against (D-092; rulebook SAL-DEF-GRAT-001, whose 1961 reference "s.17(1) Expl. / r.2BA" is wrong). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(2)(b) (p.45): "in respect of the entries against serial numbers 6 and 14 thereof, 'Salary' includes dearness allowance, if the terms of employment so provide, but excludes all other allowances and perquisites". Finance Act, 2026 (4 of 2026) searched in full: it contains no "dearness" or "terms of employment" and amends none of s.19, s.124 or Schedule XV. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10) Explanation (thc p.72): "In this clause, and in clause (10AA), 'salary' shall have the meaning assigned to it in clause (h) of rule 2 of Part A of the Fourth Schedule" — and Income-tax Act, 1961, Fourth Schedule Part A r.2(h) (thc.nic.in copy, current to Act 7 of 2019, p.853): "'salary' includes dearness allowance, if the terms of employment so provide, but excludes all other allowances and perquisites." Not searched: any amendment since Act 7 of 2019 to the provisions quoted from the thc.nic.in copy. Act 4 of 1988's assent date (24-1-1988) is as reported from the Journal of Parliamentary Information, June 1988, p.275, and was not read; its gazette issue was not found.
